summary.value:
The reviewers' concerns centred around the following:
- whether the experimental evaluation is strong enough
- whether the regulariser is sufficiently justified experimentally (experiments are needed since he paper offers no theory on regularisation or generalisation)
- whether the importance sampling correction works in practice (it is an approximation)

reviewer_concerns.value:
1. (addressed) The authors provided additional experiments.
2. (addressed) They illustrate the performance of the Brownian noise, although I see some conflation between its effect on generalisation (i.e. as a regulariser) and its effect on exploration 
3. (addressed) They provided an analysis of the error introduced by the importance sampling correction
